title: How to Moisturise Skin Overnight: A Simple Night Method
ex: A simple step-by-step method to keep skin moisturised overnight, plus how glycerin and squalane work and how to adjust for AC and winter.
rt: How to Moisturise Skin Overnight | Mirc Glow
rd: How to moisturise skin overnight: a step-by-step night method, using night cream correctly, how glycerin and squalane help, and tips for AC rooms and winter.
quick: Wash gently, leave skin slightly damp, add a hydrating serum if you like, then apply night cream within a minute to seal the moisture in. Avoid a fan or AC blowing straight on your face, and use a little extra cream on dry patches.
facts: Applying cream to slightly damp skin holds in more water.
Glycerin is a humectant that draws water into skin.
Squalane is a light emollient oil.
Mirc Glow creams do not contain squalane.
